name: Cloth and Leather Armor
summary: In Goldshire, Cloth and Leather Armor sends a trusted traveler east for gear. Marshal Dughan issues an armor marker redeemable with Sara Timberlain at Eastvale Logging Camp. The trip carries recruits beyond Guard Thomas's bridge to obtain armor for the realm's defense.

sections.title: The Marshal's Token
sections.body: Guard Thomas watches Elwynn's eastern river crossing, where murlocs and gnolls threaten the border. After you carry his report to Goldshire, Marshal Dughan recognizes your service with an official Stormwind Armor Marker. Goldshire's garrison has meager stores, so Dughan gives you a marker instead of drawing equipment from them. The marker is a military voucher that records your service to the crown.

sections.title: The Weaver of Eastvale
sections.body: East of Guard Thomas's bridge lies Eastvale Logging Camp, Elwynn's main timber operation. Sara Timberlain works there under an official commission from the Stormwind Army to make cloth and leather gear. The kingdom's central armories are strained, leaving local artisans like Sara to outfit troops and auxiliary scouts on the frontier.

faq.q: What is a Stormwind Armor Marker?
faq.answer: A Stormwind Armor Marker is an official military requisition slip issued by officers such as Marshal Dughan. Trusted recruits can use it to claim custom-fitted armor from civilian artisans commissioned by the army, instead of officers keeping bulky armor sets at their posts.

Sara Timberlain is a tailor and crafter who lives at Eastvale Logging Camp. Under contract with the Stormwind Army, she makes cloth and leather equipment for kingdom personnel and authorized auxiliary fighters.

faq.q: Where is the Eastvale Logging Camp?
faq.answer: Eastvale Logging Camp lies in far eastern Elwynn Forest. From Guard Thomas's river bridge post, take the road east into the wooded valley, where woodcutters harvest timber for the kingdom.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Dughan send adventurers to Eastvale?
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan directs recruits to Sara Timberlain at Eastvale because he does not hand out finished gear from his Goldshire post. He sends travelers east after brave deeds so they can obtain proper protection for Elwynn's defense.

faq.q: Why is the army relying on local tailors for supplies?
faq.answer: King Varian Wrynn is missing, and Stormwind's military is spread thin responding to Defias activity and wild beasts. Local defense posts rely heavily on contracted regional workers to keep their supply lines going.

faq.q: Who is Guard Thomas defending against?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas watches Elwynn Forest's eastern border and the bridge against river murlocs, prowling beasts, and the dangerous wilderness by the Redridge Mountains.

angles.text: As an Alliance defender, you see how local contracts help Elwynn's rural communities keep the Alliance functioning while the capital is politically paralyzed.
As a human, your service to Marshal Dughan and dealings with Sara Timberlain reflect the civic bonds that hold Elwynn's small homesteads together.
As a tailor, you can see in Sara Timberlain's army commission that cloth crafting is an officially sponsored military trade in the kingdom.
